name: Kettlebell Thruster
steps: Clean two kettlebells into the front rack position with your feet shoulder-width apart, elbows tucked in, and wrists straight.
Brace your abdomen and squat between your feet as far as you can keep the bells steady and both heels down.
Drive explosively upward out of the squat, using the upward leg momentum to press both kettlebells straight overhead to full arm extension.
Lower the bells smoothly back into the front rack position and transition directly into the next squat.
tips: Keep your chest upright throughout the squat so the kettlebells stay balanced over your midfoot.
Time the press as you drive out of the squat for one fluid, continuous motion.
